jobs.title: Cloud Application Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Akumen, Inc. is seeking an experienced Cloud Application Security Analyst to support the security of mission-critical web, mobile, API, and cloud-based applications. This role partners with software engineering, DevOps, quality assurance, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams to identify vulnerabilities, integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle, and strengthen secure engineering practices across the organization.

**Position Overview:**

The Cloud Application Security Analyst performs application security testing, secure design and code reviews, vulnerability triage, threat modeling, and cloud security configuration support. The successful candidate will apply Zero Trust and defense-in-depth principles, automate security validation within CI/CD pipelines, and help development teams remediate application and cloud security risks before production deployment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), and targeted manual security reviews for web and mobile applications.
* Review source code, APIs, application architectures, and cloud designs to identify security weaknesses before production release.
* Triage, prioritize, document, and support remediation of vulnerabilities, including issues aligned with the OWASP Top 10.
* Integrate automated security scanning and validation into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Jenkins.
* Conduct threat modeling for new features, applications, APIs, and microservices, and maintain supporting security evidence and diagrams.
* Protect public-facing applications, internal services, APIs, and cloud resources through appropriate network security controls, segmentation, traffic inspection, and secure configuration.
* Deploy and manage cloud networking and security controls using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or comparable Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Maintain repeatable secure configuration templa
